'''October 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (14 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 14 October 2001. [[Caleb Schnarr]] won it. It is known from Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3058">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01d3058/ colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01d3058/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Caleb Schnarr]]
